const SECRETS=[{id:1,x:468,y:278,label:'えいせいの ひみつ'},{id:2,x:904,y:277,label:'じゅんびの ひみつ'},{id:3,x:1370,y:559,label:'ちょうりの ひみつ'},{id:4,x:890,y:579,label:'かたづけの ひみつ'}];
const STORAGE_KEY='fujinoe_kitchen_adventure_v33';const W=1440,H=720;const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
let state={character:'fu',completed:[],secrets:[],px:99,py:401,bonus:false};let running=false,modalKind='',activeId=0,phase='intro',sequenceIndex=0,tapCount=0,pairIndex=0,choices=[],movingToken=0,lastFocus=null,toastTimer=null;
function read(){try{let d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY));if(d&&CHARS.some(c=>c.id===d.character)){state.character=d.character;state.completed=(Array.isArray(d.completed)?d.completed:[]).filter(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=1&&n<=12);state.completed=[...new Set(state.completed)];state.secrets=(Array.isArray(d.secrets)?d.secrets:[]).filter(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=1&&n<=4);state.secrets=[...new Set(state.secrets)];state.px=Number.isFinite(d.px)?Math.max(30,Math.min(W-30,d.px)):99;state.py=Number.isFinite(d.py)?Math.max(40,Math.min(H-35,d.py)):401;state.bonus=state.completed.length===12;return true}}catch(e){}return false}
function save(notice=false){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY,JSON.stringify({...state,version:1,updated:new Date().toISOString()}));if(notice)showToast('💾 ぼうけんを ほぞんしたよ！')}catch(e){if(notice)showToast('ほぞんできませんでした。ブラウザのせっていをかくにんしてね。')}}
function coins(){return state.completed.length*10+(state.completed.length===12?20:0)}
function showToast(t){if($('modalWrap').classList.contains('open'))return;$('toast').textContent=t;$('toast').classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').classList.remove('show'),2350)}
function showScreen(id){hideMascotCursor();$('toast').classList.remove('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);['home','story','choose','launch','play','end'].forEach(x=>$(x).classList.toggle('active',x===id));running=id==='play';if(running){requestAnimationFrame(()=>{updateHud();positionPlayer();updateCamera()})}window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'})}
function ensureChar(){if(!CHARS.some(c=>c.id===state.character))state.character='fu'}
function renderChoices(){ensureChar();$('choiceGrid').innerHTML=CHARS.map(c=>`<button class="characterCard ${state.character===c.id?'selected':''}" data-char="${c.id}" aria-pressed="${state.character===c.id}"><img src="${ASSETS[c.id]}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="${c.name}"><strong>${c.name}</strong><span class="selectedTag">${state.character===c.id?'✓ えらんだよ':'タップして えらぶ'}</span></button>`).join('');document.querySelectorAll('[data-char]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{state.character=b.dataset.char;save();renderChoices()}))}
